direct.subject: Lead Testing Results - {location}
direct.body:
Team,

The lead testing results for {location} are now available. All water samples tested below the EPA action level of 15 ppb. Detailed results are attached.

Please share with concerned parents and staff.

{sender_name}

direct.subject: Urgent: Water Quality Testing Required
direct.body:
All,

We need to schedule lead testing for all drinking water sources by {date}. This is required for compliance with state regulations.

The testing company can accommodate us next week. Please confirm availability.

{sender_name}

ambiguous.subject: Taking the Lead on Water Safety
ambiguous.body:
Hi Team,

I'll be taking the lead on our water safety initiative. As the lead coordinator, I want to ensure we lead by example in protecting student health.

Testing details to follow.

{sender_name}

indirect.subject: Follow-up on Yesterday's Discussion
indirect.body:
Hi,

Regarding what we discussed yesterday about the water situation, I think we should proceed with the consultant's recommendations before parents get involved.

Let's discuss offline.

direct.subject: ESSER III Fund Allocation Meeting
direct.body:
Finance Team,

We need to finalize our ESSER III fund allocation plan. Current proposal:
- 40% Technology infrastructure
- 30% Learning loss mitigation
- 30% Facility improvements

Please review before the board meeting.

{sender_name}

direct.subject: Re: CARES Act Spending Deadline
direct.body:
All,

Reminder: We have $2.3M in CARES Act funding that must be obligated by {date}. Priority areas include student devices and hotspots.

Need approvals ASAP.

{sender_name}

direct.subject: IEP Process Updates for 2024-25
direct.body:
Special Ed Team,

We're implementing new IEP procedures starting next semester. Key changes include streamlined documentation and enhanced parent communication protocols.

Training scheduled for {date}.

{sender_name}

direct.subject: Special Education Staffing Changes
direct.body:
Team,

Due to increased enrollment, we're adding two special education teachers and one aide. This will help maintain our student-teacher ratios.

Interviews begin next week.

{sender_name}

direct.subject: EdTech Vendor Evaluation - Final Round
direct.body:
IT Committee,

We've narrowed down to three vendors for our new LMS:
1. Canvas - $45K/year
2. Schoology - $38K/year
3. Google Classroom - $25K/year

Demo sessions scheduled for next week.

{sender_name}
